trial_court: Family Court, Jashpur, District-Jashpur (C.G.) in Civil Suit No. 29-A/2019
case_name: Smt. Chhaya Gupta vs Dheeraj Gupta
facts_of_case: Marriage between parties was solemnized on 06.05.2017. They have been living separately since March, 2019. Respondent/husband filed petition for divorce from appellant/wife on ground of cruelty. Appellant/wife denied allegations and claimed return of gifts given at time of marriage.

legal_principles.principle: The court should appreciate the oral and documentary evidence properly.
legal_principles.held: The learned Family Court minutely appreciated the oral and documentary evidence of both the parties.

legal_principles.principle: The court should direct return of Stridhan to the wife.
legal_principles.held: Hence this appeal filed by the appellant/wife.

legal_principles.principle: The court should consider granting permanent alimony and maintenance in favour of the wife.
legal_principles.held: He next submits that the learned trial Court did not appreciate the oral and documentary evidence properly and while allowing the divorce petition ought to have granted permanent alimony and maintenance in favour of appellant/wife as provided under Section 25 of the Hindu Marriage Act.

outcome.final_order: Appellant/wife entitled to get back Stridhan and cash amount given to respondent/husband. Respondent/husband directed to return Rs.5,00,000/- and steel almirah, mixy, double bed, cooler, dressing table, LED T.V. and utensils within one month.
